## About me

I am a senior data and analytics consultant based in Melbourne. I recently completed my PhD research at the University of Melbourne, where I applied natural language processing (NLP) to large-scale workplace text data. I also ran my own research and analytics firm for six years, working with clients in media, market research and e-commerce. My strengths: technical depth, practical problem-solving, and clear communication.

## Tools & technologies

- **Languages:** Python, SQL, R, Bash
- **Data analysis & modelling:** pandas, NumPy, statsmodels
- **Machine learning & NLP:** scikit-learn, PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy
- **Statistics:** experimental design and A/B testing, multilevel and longitudinal models, regression and mediation analysis, SEM
- **Infrastructure:** Git, AWS, Saturn Cloud (GPU computing)
- **Visualisation & reporting:** Tableau, Matplotlib, Seaborn, LaTeX
